title: Clearwater Paper Refinances Debt and Secures New Credit Facility
summary: SPOKANE, Wash., September 21, 2026--Clearwater Paper Corporation (NYSE: CLW) today announced the successful refinancing of its senior notes due in 2028, along with the refinancing of both its existing term revolver credit facility and its existing ABL revolving credit facility. The existing notes and credit facilities have been replaced with a new term loan and revolving credit facility, meaningfully extending the company’s debt maturities.
